findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Submariner без даты. Самая чистая и симметричная" → 4 lines (11 words, 65.3px, a paragraph set above 36px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 6 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 11 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Механизм", "Акустика спуска калибра", "Механическая кинематическая цепь", "Официальная розничная цена").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 5 gradient fill(s): div.whero__sticky → radial-gradient(55% 60% at 64% 46%, rgba(170, 186, 206, 0.12), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 70%), radial-gradient(30% 30%  | li → linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(159, 233, 196, 0.12), rgba(12, 14, 17, 0.6)) | div.tco-metric-card.tco-metric-card--profit → linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.08) 0%, rgba(12, 14, 17, 0.8) 100%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 3 typefaces in use (Onest, Cormorant Garamond, JetBrains Mono).
3 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 1172px at 1968px; 696px at 4676px; 400px at 6580px (the screen is 900px tall).
findings.fix: A fixed picture layer covers the screen here, so the DOM cannot tell whether the stretch is empty: check the screenshots. Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.

findings.message: 26 panel borders are dark against their ground: #d9e6e6 on #07080a (15.66:1) | #d9e6e6 on #07080a (15.66:1) | #d9e6e6 on #101216 (14.65:1)
findings.fix: A panel border is a whisper: about 1.1–1.3:1 against its ground on a light screen (#e5e7eb–#ededed on white), and about 1.2–1.5:1 on a dark one (#1a1a1a on #000, #2e2e2e on #111). Darker lines turn the screen into a grid of boxes; keep the stronger line for controls.
One radius for panels, one for controls, full round only for pills and avatars.

findings.message: 25 of 25 numeric table cells are left-aligned.
findings.fix: Right-align numbers, amounts and percentages (and their column headers) so the digits line up.

findings.message: Only 0 of 6 blocks start on the first 1440px screen.
findings.fix: Every block the brief names shows its header and first rows on the first desktop screen: size the headline block to its question, cap long lists with "View all", and put time-sensitive blocks before long tables.

findings.message: 1 card(s) hold a blank band inside: 387px in "Ещё Rolex".
findings.fix: A card stretches to its neighbour only when it has content to fill. Keep a legend or a note directly under its chart (only an action or a total may sit at a stretched card's foot), let a short card keep its own height (align-items: start), and let a filtered block shrink to its rows.
An app screen is not a landing page: the title is 18-32px (20-24px on a phone).
Figures run 16-40px on app screens; none of the studied screens reaches 48px. Size and isolation make a number loud, not display type.
